architecture.preserved_compatibility: All 53 moved legacy modules are exact sys.modules aliases. trace_recorder and raven_execution are public compatibility aggregates with exact object exports and no extracted implementation. Production code imports canonical implementations; AST regression checks old facades are not reintroduced.
architecture.finite_registry: Every admitted pure operation has an explicit lazy callable loader; unknown names fail. Pre-fork worker warming retains only the chosen operation. No computed module names, reflection or TYPE_CHECKING edges hide dependencies.
architecture.effect_ports: Narrow validated ExecutionNavigation and TraceBrowserEffects callbacks are composed in workbench. Read-only connection scope, script formatting and submission preparation live below UI owners; callbacks resolve current canonical handler attributes so monkeypatches remain effective.

packages.baseline: Readers imported cli or root launch composition for parsing/scope, onboarding service delegated upward into launchers.
packages.implementation: Shared canonical option grammar, lower connection scope, separate onboarding CLI callback composition, canonical launcher/workload/qualification and configuration families. Pure Heavy plan calls allocation_adapters.prepare without constructing owned socketpairs.
packages.simpler_alternative: Duplicating parser/scope logic or keeping directory-only wrappers leaves policy drift or the same source cycles. Actual extraction shares one implementation and retains old module identity.
packages.compatibility: Product help retains the original dashboard description; installed entrypoints target entry.launcher. Both python -m raven and python raven work. Existing Config/Resolved identities remain exact at legacy imports.

packages.baseline: Capture dispatched CLI and document/browser logic shared UI dependencies; provenance created a stream/export cycle.
packages.implementation: Capture and CLI separate, common provenance leaf, pure document exporter below browser request. All trace implementations now canonical tracing members.
packages.simpler_alternative: Late imports only defer the same dependency cycle. Explicit leaves preserve the existing algorithm and data fidelity without adding an executor or buffering whole recordings.

packages.recovery: Failure injection continues to exercise actual recorder/diagnostic owners; optional failures preserve workload stdout, argv, exit status, original exception and trace partial state. Existing content-addressed cache, no-clobber permissions and governed ownership cleanup remain unchanged.
